label: LTS · v2.5.1
author: Codexadi25
message: fix: restore LTS CSS architecture broken by cc52980
changelog: 🔒 **Strict Username Policy & Validation** — Block special characters (except underscores) during registration, admin bulk-creation, and profile settings, enforced at Mongoose schema, controller, route, and input layers.
🛡️ **Login Security Interception** — Login attempts using usernames containing special characters are instantly caught by an interception layer displaying an explicit security warning.
🔑 **Two-Factor Admin Deletion Confirmation** — Admin-scoped deletes now prompt for exact username confirmation to prevent accidental account deletion.

⚡ **Inline Smart SOP Panel Integration** — The "Smart SOP" button now opens the SOP view/editor inline inside the dashboard tabs rather than redirecting the user to a separate browser tab, providing a more cohesive experience.
✨ Added live oninput frontend sanitization for the username input field during registration and profile settings.

label: LTS · v2.5.0
author: Codexadi25
message: feat: v2.5.0 — Version History, Masonry PN UI, Font Scaling & Access Policy Enforcement
changelog: 🆕 Version History modal — click the footer version tag for a live commit timeline
🆕 GitHub Actions CI auto-bumps version & broadcasts update notifications on every push
🆕 In-app update notifications sent to all users via the Messages section on each release
✨ Private Notes redesigned as a masonry gallery (Pinterest-style dynamic card layout)
✨ 4-level font size scaling: Small / Medium / Large / Extra Large (per-user setting)
✨ Private Notes access policy enforced — admins see all; users manage only their own
🐛 Fixed Private Notes Edit/Delete buttons (SVG nested click delegation via .closest())
🐛 Footer now correctly sits below the 100vh dashboard wrapper
